text: Plan: build a California cropland-change layer from NAIP (s3://naip-analytic, us-west-2, Requester-Pays, public domain). 1) Select 2020 and 2022 NAIP tiles for the Central Valley. 2) Compute NDVI from the 4-band imagery. 3) Classify cropland vs non-cropland and diff the two years. Limitations: NAIP is collected every 2-3 years and only in summer; Requester-Pays transfer costs apply, so pre-stage a sample in us-west-2.
